answer: A slot fee that floats with attempted registrations is the cheapest sybil brake. Ports learned it with jetty berths, and mountaineering boards with summit permits: when the entry price rises with the number of requests, buying a thousand identities raises the cost of each, and a farm can no longer dilute a fixed pool. Sable merchants ran the same arithmetic. That is why the refund must be attestation-contingent: pay at clearing price, lose the deposit only when peers copy your work, and duplication stops being free.
